Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the run chase. The umpires are out in the middle and the South Africa Women Under-19 players make their way out onto the field. Shafali Verma and Shweta Sehrawat will open the innings for India Women Under-19 and will want to get off to a flier. Ayanda Hlubi has been handed the new ball and will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Simone Lourens is up for a chat and she says that she is delighted and she enjoyed it. Adds that she went after the ball and scored the runs for her team. Ends by saying that they are here to win it and they will give their best.

South Africa Women Under-19 got off to a flier as they put on 56 runs for the opening wicket in just four overs. Elandri Rensburg was dismissed and Oluhle Siyo followed her back to the shed on a golden duck. Kayla Reyneke departed after a labored inning but Madison Landsman joined forces with Simone Lourens to take the attack to the India Women Under-19 bowlers. The latter was unfortunately run out for a well-made 61 in 44 deliveries and Madison Landsman followed after making 32 in 17. Karabo Meso and Miane Smit played handy cameos to provide the finishing touches to get their team to a massive total.

This is a remarkable batting effort from South Africa Women Under-19! They have managed to put up a formidable total of 166 on the board and they will be absolutely thrilled with their effort. Their batters came to the party at the right time and now are favorites to clinch an unlikely win. The India Women Under-19 bowlers will be absolutely disappointed with their effort and they started in the worst possible manner conceding 20 runs in the first over. Sonam Yadav did get the breakthrough but was far too expensive on the whole. Shafali Verma picked up two wickets and conceded just 31 runs in her 4 overs but Parshavi Chopra was the pick of the bowlers taking one wicket and conceding just 15 runs in her full quota of 4.

FOUR! Fuller and on off, Miane Smit shimmies down the wicket and lofts it over mid on for a boundary. The fielder makes an attempt to stop it at the fence but couldn't. South Africa Women Under-19 end their innings for 166/5.
Fuller and on leg, Karabo Meso slogs it towards mid-wicket for one more.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Miane Smit flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Lands it on off, turning away, Miane Smit looks to slog it but misses.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Miane Smit moves forward and lofts it over mid off for another boundary. Back to back boundaries now!
FOUR! Bowls it fuller and on off, Miane Smit slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Good start to the final over for South Africa!
FOUR! Errs her line completely and bowls it down leg, Karabo Meso looks to sweep it but ends up getting a bottom edge as the ball races away the fine leg fence.
Shorter and on middle, Miane Smit pulls it towards square leg for one.
Around off, blocked off the front foot.
Slightly shorter one, this is pulled towards square leg for one.

Catch it... is the call. Fuller and on off, Karabo Meso looks to flick it but gets a top edge as it carries towards short fine leg. Richa Ghosh has no idea where the ball is and it lands safely. The batters collect two.
Fuller and on middle, Miane Smit works it towards mid-wicket for one.
Slower one, outside off, Karabo Meso looks to slog it but misses. Parshavi Chopra appeals to it thinking there was an edge. The umpire says NO.
Fuller and on off, Miane Smit flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Miane Smit makes her way to the middle.

OUT! PLUMB! Bowls it on off, some turn and bounce as well. Landsman shuffles across and looks to paddle it but misses it completely and gets a rap on her thigh. A loud appeal and the finger goes up. Madison Landsman goes back into the hut after her cameo.
Lands it on off, Karabo Meso taps it to deep covers for one.
Slower and outside off, Karabo Meso plays it with soft hands back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Fuller and on middle, Karabo Meso hangs back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Karabo Meso lofts it towards long off for one.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Karabo Meso rocks back and pulls it over square leg for a boundary!
This is played towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Madison Landsman hangs back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary!
On off, pulled towards square leg for one.

OUT! RUN OUT! Fuller and on leg, Simone Lourens works it towards deep square leg and calls for a quick second. Gongadi Trisha in the deep is quick to react and throws it to Richa Ghosh who stumps it and the finger gows up.
SIX! All the way. Fuller and outside off, Madison Landsman moves to her right and powers it over fine leg for a maximum. Excellent shot!
Lands it on middle, Simone Lourens turns it uppishly towards mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, Simone Lourens eases it to covers.
Turning away from outside off, Simone Lourens looks to slap it but gets beaten.
Slightly shorter one, Madison Landsman slaps it towards long on. It does carry but lands safely. They collect one.
Slower and on off, Simone Lourens eases it to covers and scampers through for a single.
FOUR! This one lands outside off, Madison Landsman hangs back, opens the face of the bat, and guides it through third man for another boundary. 16 off the over!
FOUR! Bowls it on off, Madison Landsman gets on her knee to slog sweep it but gets an inside edge as the ball races away the fine leg fence. Lucky boundary!
Slightly shorter and outside off, Madison Landsman cuts it to the point fielder.
FOUR! Another one down leg, Madison Landsman gets on her knee and paddles it through fine leg for another boundary!
Bowls it on off, Madison Landsman taps it to the woman at covers.
FOUR! Errs her line and gets punished. Slightly shorter and down leg, Madison Landsman shuffles across and paddles tit through fine leg for a boundary!
Soumya Tiwari has been brought into the attack.
Flighted up, on middle, Madison Landsman taps it to covers for one.
Outside off, blocked out off the front foot.
Bowls it on off, Simone Lourens pushes it towards extra covers for one.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and just outside off, Simone Lourens looks to slap it but gets a bottom edge. It misses the keeper and rolls through third man for a boundary!
A low full toss, Madison Landsman drills it towards deep covers for one.
Bowls it on off, Madison Landsman eases it to the woman at point.
Wide! Lands it wide outside off, Madison Landsman lets it go.
Fuller and on off, Madison Landsman pushes it to long on for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Simone Lourens punches it to covers for one.
A low full toss on off, this is played towards point for one.
Madison Landsman makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Fuller and on off, Kayla Reyneke rocks back and looks to force it over deep square leg, but ends but hits it from her toe end of the bat. It carries towards deep square leg. Gongadi Trisha settles under it and pouches it comfortably.
Commentary.Howout: c Gongadi Trisha b Shafali Verma

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it on off, Kayla Reyneke blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller and on off, Simone Lourens pushes it to long off for one.
Outside off, blocked out solidly.
Slower one on off, Kayla Reyneke eases it to the fielder at covers.
A slight mix-up but safe. A low full toss, Kayla Reyneke sweeps it to mid-wicket. The nonstriker runs but Kayla Reyneke sends her back. The fielder throws it to the bowlers end but she is well safe.
Bowls it down leg, Kayla Reyneke tickles it to fine leg. Richa Ghosh runs to collect it as the batters collect two.
Another fuller one, Simone Lourens pushes it to mid off for one.
Lands it on middle, Kayla Reyneke eases it to covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Simone Lourens drops it to the woman at covers.
Turning in from outside off, Kayla Reyneke taps it to covers for one more.
Fifty up for Simone Lourens. Fuller and on off, Simone Lourens turns it to mid-wicket for one. Excellent knock!
Bowls it on off, this is played towards the fielder at covers.
Lands it on leg, Kayla Reyneke works it towards mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Simone Lourens punches it towards covers for one.

Drinks! South Africa Women Under-19 were off to a flier but India Women Under-19 did well to claw their way up in the game. They will be looking to bag some quick wickets now and restrict South Africa Women to a low total.
Loopy delivery to end the over, served full and outside the off stump. Simone Lourens drives this to long off and takes a single to retain strike.
This is short and outside off. Simone Lourens rocks back and thumps this straight to cover.
Loopy delivery outside off. Kayla Reyneke pushes this down to long off for one.
Flights this one full and wide outside off. Kayla Reyneke leaves this one alone and looks for a wide but this is inside the tram line.
A full toss this time outside the off pole. Simone Lourens misses out as she thumps this straight to long on for a run.
Parshavi Chopra flights this one full and just outside off. Simone Lourens defends this back towards the bowler.
Continues bowling short and in line with the stumps. Kayla Reyneke flicks this towards deep backward square leg and they run well to take two runs.
This is short and outside off. Simone Lourens cross bats this down to long on for one.
This is short and in line with the stumps. Kayla Reyneke pulls this towards deep square leg and they take a single.
Bowls this one full as well and in line with the stumps. Kayla Reyneke defends this back towards the bowler.
Goes full once again and outside off. Kayla Reyneke knocks this to the cover fielder.
Soniya Mendhiya floats this one full and outside off. Simone Lourens knocks this to cover and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Tosses this one full and outside off. Simone Lourens eases this down to long off and takes one to keep strike.
Continues to bowl short and outside off. Simone Lourens looks to cut but misses.
Short once again and outside off. Kayla Reyneke cross bats this down to long on for a single.
Flighted delivery bowled full and in line with the stumps. Kayla Reyneke knocks this back towards the bowler.
This is bowled short and outside the off stump. Kayla Reyneke looks to cut but gets an under edge into the off side.
Parshavi Chopra floats this one full and outside the off stump. Kayla Reyneke dabs this back towards the bowler.
Parshavi Chopra comes into the attack.
Goes back to bowling short and in line with the stumps. Kayla Reyneke pulls this towards deep square leg for a run to get off the mark.
Bowls this one full and outside off. Kayla Reyneke guides this towards backward point.
This is short and outside off. Simone Lourens pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is short and angles down leg. Simone Lourens looks to make room and gets beaten.

FOUR! Simone Lourens fighting a lone battle here! Soniya Mendhiya bowls this full and outside off. Simone Lourens thumps this straight to mid off but a misfield allows the ball to race to the boundary.
This is short and outside off. Simone Lourens hits this uppishly towards extra cover.
Floats this one full and outside the off pole. Kayla Reyneke pushes this towards cover-point.
Back to bowling short and in line with the stumps. Kayla Reyneke flicks this towards square leg.
Goes full and outside the off pole. Kayla Reyneke strokes this straight to point.
WIDE! Strays down leg stump this time and the umpire indicates wide.
This is floated full and outside off. Simone Lourens powers this to long on for one.
Continues bowling short and outside off. Simone Lourens finds the fielder again.
Archana Devi bowls this short and outside off. Simone Lourens cuts this straight to cover-point.
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps. Kayla Reyneke defends this back down the pitch.
WIDE! Goes full and strays down leg. This is called wide by the umpire.
This is short as well and outside off. Kayla Reyneke knocks this towards cover-point.
Kayla Reyneke is the new batter.

OUT! BOWLED! Shafali Verma wins the battle of the captains! She bowls this one on a shorter length and just outside the stumps. Gets the ball to skid through and finds Oluhle Siyo on the back foot. She tries to work this away but misses and the off pole is pegged back. India Women Under-19 trying to claw their way back here after an explosive start. Two wickets down now and South Africa Women Under-19 will need to consolidate a bit here.
Continues bowling short and outside off. Simone Lourens pulls this to deep square leg for one.
This is short as well and outside off. Simone Lourens pulls and finds the mid-wicket fielder this time.
FOUR! Simone Lourens continues the onslaught from the other end! Simone Lourens slaps this towards deep mid-wicket and collects four runs.
Oluhle Siyo walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Finally a breakthrough for India Women Under-19! Much-needed for them as this game was going just one way! Sonam Yadav flights this one full and outside off. Elandri Rensburg looks to sweep across the line and gets a top edge to the leg side. Richa Ghosh goes running to her left and takes a comfortable catch. India Women Under-19 finally draw first blood and will be eager for a few more.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Sonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: This is short as well and outside off. Elandri Rensburg slaps this straight to cover-point.
FOUR! Bowls this short and outside off. Elandri Rensburg is on fire as well and she smacks this through covers for four runs.

DROPPED AND SIX! Sonam Yadav loops this up nicely and bowls this full, outside off. Elandri Rensburg looks to go aerial once again but mistimes her shot towards long off. The fielder comes running to her right and gets her hand on it but spills it over the ropes for a maximum.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Elandri Rensburg looks to heave across the line and gets beaten.
Sonam Yadav flights this one full and outside off, Simone Lourens strokes this to deep cover for one.
This is full and angled into the stumps. Simone Lourens clips this towards mid-wicket who misfields and allows a single to be taken.
Bowls it on off, Elandri Rensburg drills it to long on for a single.
Floats this one full and in line with the stumps. Elandri Rensburg blocks this bakc down the pitch.
FOUR! Elandri Rensburg wants to join the party! Archana Devi bowls this short and outside off. Elandri Rensburg cuts this towards deep point for four more runs.
Bowls this slightly short and outside off. Elandri Rensburg dabs this towards point.
SIX! All the way. Elandri Rensburg welcomes Archana Devi with a maximum. Fuller and on off, Elandri Rensburg gets on her knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for a maximum!
Archana Devi comes into the attack now.
Bowls it on off, Simone Lourens eases it to the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Simone Lourens hangs back and slaps it past extra covers for a boundary! Three in a row now. South Africa Women Under-19 are off to a flier.
FOUR! There is no stopping Simone Lourens here! This is full as well and outside off. Simone Lourens thumps this into the gap towards deep cover-point for four more runs.
FOUR! Sonam Yadav gets the treatment now! This is flighted full and outside off. Simone Lourens crunches this towards deep cover for four runs.
Floats this one full and outside off. Elandri Rensburg looks to heave this into the leg side but gets a top edge that goes just over mid on for a single.
Sonam Yadav Flights this one full and outside the off stump. Gets sharp turn and beats the outside edge of the bat.
Sonam Yadav to bowl from the other end.

This one is full and in line with the stumps. Simone Lourens looks to clip this away as well but gets an inside edge on her pads. 20 runs from the first over and what a start for South Africa Women Under-19!

NO BALL AND FOUR! Oh my! Things are going from bad to worse for Shabnam MD! This is bowled full and angling down leg. Simone Lourens whips this towards deep backward square leg and collects four more runs. To make matters worse Shabnam MD has overstepped and she will have to bowl another delivery which will be a Free-Hit!

FOUR! Third boundary in the over and Simone Lourens is on the charge! This is bowled on a length and into the pads. Simone Lourens whips this off her legs towards deep square leg and collects four runs.

SIX! That is over the ropes! What a good start for South Africa Women Under-19! This is bowled slightly short and outside the off stump. Simone Lourens pulls this over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
FOUR! Simone Lourens opens her account in style! This is bowled on a good length and just outside off stump, Simone Lourens pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Bowls this on a good length as well and outside off. Simone Lourens knocks this straight to mid off.
Shabnam MD starts off with a good length delivery angled into the stumps from outside off. Elandri Rensburg clips this towards square leg and takes a single to get off the mark.

We are all set for the game to begin. The players and the umpires have made their way out in the middle. Elandri Rensburg and Simone Lourens are the openers for South Africa Women Under-19. Shabnam MD comes to bowl. Here we go...

Richa Ghosh is in for a quick chat. She says that shes is excited since it is the first time this tournament is played and also the lats time she can represent at this level. Claims that they have a good side and it is a great opportunity to win the title. Mentions that she is a senior team player so she needs to guide her team. Explains that they understood the condition of the pitch and the weather and will use it to their advantage.
PITCH REPORT - The pitch is flat and it will have a good bounce. The pacers will enjoy and it doesn't offer much turn. The average score should be around 160.

Shafali Verma the skipper of India Women Under-19 says that it's fine and they will fight for it. Adds that they are happy with the conditions and happy to go. Ends by saying that they trust the players and will look to win it.

Oluhle Siyo the skipper of South Africa Women Under-19 says that they had really good preparation and they know how the pitch plays. Claims that they took good things from the series which they will look to execute in this game.

India Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Shweta Sehrawat, Shafali Verma (C), Gongadi Trisha, Soumya Tiwari, Richa Ghosh (WK), Soniya Mendhiya, Hrishita Basu, Archana Devi, Parshavi Chopra, Shabnam MD, Sonam Yadav.

South Africa Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Elandri Rensburg, Simone Lourens, Oluhle Siyo (C), Kayla Reyneke, Madison Landsman, Karabo Meso (WK), Miane Smit, Jenna Evans, Seshnie Naidu, Ayanda Hlubi, Nthabiseng Nini.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of South Africa Women Under-19. They have elected to BAT first.

India Women Under-19 are probably one of the favorites going into this competition with two hard-hitting senior players in their midst. They have some exciting talents coming through and have a strong batting lineup but they stumbled during the run chase in their last warm-up match against Bangladesh Women Under-19. As with most subcontinent teams, they possess a good spin bowling unit with multiple variations at their disposal and some good seam bowlers to turn to. Will this encounter be close or one-sided? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.

South Africa Women Under-19 are playing in home conditions and are in a poor run of form as they lost the recent series to India Women Under-19 without winning a single game and lost both their warm-up games as well. However, with the crowd behind them, it would be too early to count them out as they have enough quality to pull off a surprise. They have quite a few all-rounders in their ranks and that allows them to bat deep and gives them extra options in their bowling. Their batting has been vulnerable though and this puts a lot of onus on the bowlers to carry the game.

Hello, and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen to our coverage of match number 3 in the inaugural ICC Women’s Under-19 T20 World Cup as we witness an enticing clash in Group D between hosts South Africa Women Under-19 and India Women Under-19 at the Willowmoore Park in Benoni. Both teams will be eager to kickstart their campaign with a win as they hunt for this historic trophy. With three teams set to progress from the group, the two teams will not be too worried about the result but will want to get a winning momentum going.
... MATCH DAY ...
